content.text: Epididymal pain & swelling thought to be secondary to retrograde infection or reflux of urine –
: relief of pain w/ scrotal elevation
: stroking of inner thigh causes elevation of ipsilateral testis
– enlarged epididymis, increased testicular blood flow
, bed rest, scrotal support, cool packs
Prostate gland inflammation secondary to an ascending infection
: hesitancy, poor or interrupted stream, straining to void, incomplete emptying
AVOID prostatic massage in acute (may cause bacteremia)
